Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Modern WinUI 3 screen capture, true pixel redaction, and multi-page PDF export.

English.Keywords: screenshot, screen capture, snip tool, redact image, annotate screenshot, screenshot to pdf, markup tool
English.Char_Desc_80: Capture, annotate, and redact Windows 11 screenshots. Export PNG, JPEG, or PDF.
English.Char_Desc_250: Cropmark captures and annotates screenshots on Windows 11. Free includes solid redaction, numbered steps, and watermark-free PNG/JPEG/single-image PDF export. Pro adds batch export, multi-image projects, saved styles, and PDF merging.
English.Char_Desc_450: Cropmark is a Windows 11 screenshot tool. Capture a region or full screen, add arrows, text and numbered steps, and replace sensitive pixels with solid redaction in exported images. Free exports PNG, JPEG and single-image PDF without watermarks. Pro adds batch export, multi-image projects, saved styles and PDF merging. Review exports before sharing; original captures and editable projects may retain original content.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Cropmark captures and annotates screenshots on Windows 11 build 22000 or later (x64). Free includes region/full-screen capture, arrows, text, numbered steps and solid redaction. Export PNG, JPEG or single-image PDF without watermarks. Pro adds saved styles, batch export, multi-image projects and merging images into a PDF. Redaction replaces covered pixels in the exported result and checks it before saving. Review exports before sharing; keep original captures, editable projects and backups private. No app account, screenshot uploads or analytics. Microsoft Store handles Pro purchases and license checks.
